comment: Tokyo Night. Source: https://github.com/tokyo-night/tokyo-night-vscode-theme (themes/tokyo-night-color-theme.json). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2018-present Enkia; the text is in LICENSE-tokyo-night. Roles: text = editor.foreground, weak = foreground, rule = editorLineNumber.foreground, accent = terminal.ansiMagenta, run = terminal.ansiBlue, ok = terminal.ansiGreen, error = terminal.ansiRed, add = gitDecoration.addedResourceForeground, remove = gitDecoration.deletedResourceForeground, tint = list.activeSelectionBackground, code = textCodeBlock.background, background = editor.background. The iOS app uses #1c1d29 for its tint, but upstream list.activeSelectionBackground is #202330, so the app's value is stale. Adjusted for contrast, nothing else changed: remove #914c54 (gitDecoration.deletedResourceForeground) -> #9a5159: lightness 43% -> 46% for 3:1 on #1a1b26 (was 2.74:1).
